# AQ Beds

> AQ Beds is a UK bed and bedroom furniture retailer selling handcrafted beds direct to
> customers since 2018. The range covers ottoman beds with gas-lift storage, divan beds,
> luxury velvet beds, sofas, wardrobes and bedroom furniture. Free UK delivery, next-day
> on orders placed before 20:00 Europe/London, Monday to Saturday. Payment is cash on
> delivery.

Canonical domain: https://www.aqbeds.com

## Collections

- [All beds](https://www.aqbeds.com/shop): every bed and furniture product in one catalogue.
- [Ottoman beds](https://www.aqbeds.com/category/ottoman-beds): gas-lift storage beds, storage under the whole mattress base.
- [Divan beds](https://www.aqbeds.com/category/divan-beds): divan bases with one to four built-in drawers.
- [Luxury beds](https://www.aqbeds.com/category/luxury-beds): wingback, sleigh and gold-strip detail bed frames.
- [Sofas](https://www.aqbeds.com/category/sofas): velvet sofas and sofa beds.
- [Wardrobes](https://www.aqbeds.com/category/wardrobes): sliding and hinged wardrobes.
- [Bedroom furniture](https://www.aqbeds.com/category/bedroom-furniture): matching bedroom pieces.

## Buying facts

- Delivery: free across the UK, next-day delivery for orders confirmed Monday to Saturday
  before 20:00 Europe/London; the delivery date is chosen at checkout.
- Payment: cash on delivery only. No cards, no finance, no buy-now-pay-later.
- Guarantee: every bed is inspected at the door on delivery; a faulty item is replaced
  free with next-day delivery.
- Sizes: from 2ft6 small single to 6ft super king on beds; mattresses can be included or
  supplied separately depending on the model.
- Assembly: divan bases arrive assembled; ottoman and luxury frames are assembled on
  delivery.
